appearance.direction: Modern minimal sheet/dialog using existing Basketra component language.
appearance.rule: No literal 'por formulario' wording. The two entry modes are named 'Crear' and 'Escanear'.

behavior.suggestions: Debounced local catalog suggestions. Stale requests are aborted/ignored. Selecting a saved product fills the same draft and exposes selected-store price context.
behavior.size: For a linked product, size/package comes from its variant. Choosing another saved size switches variant. 'Other/new size' opens the product editor instead of creating a list-only duplicate product size.
behavior.store: Defaults to the list reference store. Selecting another store creates a per-item override.
behavior.scanProduct: Capture/upload product photo, analyze it, then hydrate this exact same draft/editor state. Do not open or keep a separate proposal form after analysis.
behavior.scanTicket: Delegates to the existing ticket capture/import flow; do not fabricate a single-product form from a multi-line receipt.
behavior.errors: Preserve all user-entered draft values on AI, network or store lookup failure.

responsive.mobile: Bottom-sheet style is acceptable but not mandatory; keep fields in reading order and CTA reachable above safe-area/navigation.
responsive.desktop: Dialog or centered sheet may use columns while preserving the exact same field/content contract.
